checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13; all volumes within p300 multi (40, 125, ~167, 180, 100) and p1000 (250, mix 400) ranges; wells under capacity; reservoir columns within 15 mL per check; simulator passed.

Check fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact passed (48 distinct tips); every pick_up_tip is followed by drop_tip; reagent dispensed at col.top without touching sample liquid; fresh tips for removal, elution and recovery.

Recovers 100 µL (p300m.aspirate(ELUTION_VOL...) in recovery loop) rather than ~80 µL, aspirating the full eluate near beads at 0.8 mm; also adds unspecified bead premix and elution mixing, so it is not fully faithful.
Check 48_samples_to_odd_columns passed; sources zip to sample_wells built from odd columns 1,3,5,7,9,11; each sample maps to its own well and elution well.
Beads 40, IPA 2x125, sample 250 with p1000.mix(5,...), delay 5 min, mag.engage + 4 min delay, remove 540 µL to waste; checks binding_volumes, mix_5x, incubation, magnet_4min all passed.
Two 500 µL ethanol washes each removed via remove_liquid with magnet engaged, then 4 min delay and mag.disengage() before elution; checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min passed.
Elution 100 µL off-magnet with mix, 30 s, magnet 90 s are correct, but recovery aspirates and dispenses ELUTION_VOL=100 µL rather than about 80 µL.

judge.summary: The protocol follows the binding, wash, dry and elution sequence with correct volumes, timings, magnet use and per-sample tips, and every simulator check passed. It recovers the full 100 µL eluate instead of about 80 µL, so elution_recovery and fidelity_to_paper score 0.
